ST0086 WP-04 Part B, first in decision 100's one judge run, in vc's order:
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-status-v2 (4ae2585f7479): AC-04.6's CLI share.
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-wait-v2 (2421b3d9719d): AC-04.4, with slots wait, slots watch and the hook's slots pending.
- ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (8126a568631b): the page's half.
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-init-v1 (e8aee9ac86d6): AC-04.5.
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-ats-v1 (f649be3fa3ea): the AT markers on Part A's tests, a test for AC-04.2's lane re-open and LaneBusy close, and the NamedMismatch text asserted.
- ic's pipeline-cell-width-v4 (e058514c0734): CSS only.
Then cc's 0657 v2 (doing 97), cc's ST0081 WP-02 v1 (doing 98) and ic's 0658 v3.
ONE RUN, hv's ruling as vc decision 100, which replaces decision 96(1)'s train after this one, so 0657 lands with Part B. MEASURED 2026-10-27 at 09:06Z by cc's clock: in a scratch index every bank applies in that order on main 21d764a94 at its recorded patch-id, to tree 4944cfe4135a, equal to vc's.
THE JUDGE is Part B's re-ask, in its place, through judge-rerun.sh, when molt-vc closes L1 (devbin, molt, utilz, gtools cut, brewed and reinstalled: hv's layer order, molt-vc decision 22). After a green run: one landing chain, one build all, one kovacs preflight and one push.
A RED in any bank comes back to its author, read by its mechanism; the bank is fixed or pulled and the run repeats once. A red in cc's Part B banks is fixed forward in tmp/wt-cc-0086b, detached on scratch tip ddc43caba. A fix-forward bank carries no CHANGELOG hunk, and its line goes to vc as text. A bank that moves is told to vc and ic, and a later bank that no longer applies over it is re-banked by its author.
OWED IN THE ONE LANDING CHAIN:
- AT rows for AC-04.1 to AC-04.6 and AC-04.8 to AC-04.13 (slots.rs for all but 04.5, coordinator.rs for 04.5), with `intent at lint ST0086` before the commit.
- design.md through `intent st attach`, first in design.md's sequence, ahead of ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/design-cells-v1 (the pipeline cells' sentence) and 0658's Primary paragraph: controller_unreadable, lanes[].queue and line 67's UNREADABLE, plus pending's cost measured with the judge's binary under `--lane none`, as dated figures and never as a bound.
cc's CHANGELOG lines went to vc as text at 09:06Z by cc's clock, for vc's ref and the landing commit: none for wp04b-ats-v1, which is tests only, and the lines for 0657 v2 and WP-02 v1.
Worktree removals wait for molt-vc's Spotlight word, under decision 98 as amended. No push, no release.
